actions.detail: Preflight and WorkPreflight froze schema normalize -> JCS -> vectors -> Python/Dart validation -> digest storage under the P03-004 local projection.

Consulted the RFC 8785 primary specification for I-JSON rejection, ECMAScript number serialization, UTF-16 property ordering, string escaping, and UTF-8 generation; phase scope remained bound to sealed guidance.

Added the complete reference-only Behavior Manifest schema, shared vectors, Python and Dart JCS/SHA-256 implementations, and fail-closed negative tests without adding dependencies or storing prompt/secret bodies.

A read-only vector-print command failed when the Windows GBK console could not encode the Euro sign; setting PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 produced all remaining expected hashes without changing implementation semantics.

The required full-repository Flutter analyzer reproduced three pre-existing stale widget-test errors and 42 unrelated warnings. It reported zero findings on P03-005 paths; BLK-P03-005-FLUTTER-BASELINE records the out-of-allowlist root cause and formal follow-up.
The reversible scoped analyzer passed with no issues for lib/core/agent/behavior_digest.dart and test/behavior_digest_test.dart; Python 30/30 and Dart 4/4 affected tests also passed.
A read-only Import-PowerShellDataFile attempt exceeded a 10-second orchestration timeout before returning Catalog data.

Direct data-file import cannot evaluate the Catalog's dynamic null expression. A bounded raw UTF-8 substring read recovered the exact P03-005 entry and identified that its generated file_allowlist omitted the two contract files required by the sealed execplan card.
Added exact P03-005 Verify, Security, Evidence, WorksetVerify, and RollbackVerify adapters plus the two execplan-mandated contract paths, without changing Catalog bytes.
The complete Agent CI suite passed with 190 unit/integration tests, 42 contract tests, and all format, lint, type, secret, clock, license, and dependency audit checks.
